column3: NASB follows the critical text (“forefather”) and reorders the verse.
NASB renders “ground of boasting” as “something to boast about” and “toward God” as “before God.”
The quotation is in capitals; “for righteousness” is rendered “AS RIGHTEOUSNESS.”
NASB renders “reward” as “wage,” “grace” as “a favor,” and “debt” as “what is due.”
NASB renders “for righteousness” as “as righteousness.”
NASB renders “declares the blessedness of” as “speaks of the blessing upon.” A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
The quotation is in capitals.
NASB follows the critical text (“whose”); the quotation is in capitals, and “reckon” is rendered “TAKE INTO ACCOUNT.”
NASB follows the critical text; “the circumcision” is rendered “the circumcised.” The quotation is in capitals.
NASB adds “while he was” and “while.”
NASB renders “in uncircumcision” as “without being circumcised.”
NASB follows the critical text; “walking in the steps” is rendered “follow in the steps,” and it reorders the verse.
NASB follows the critical text and reorders the verse.
Close to the Greek.
NASB follows the critical text (“but”); “transgression” is rendered “violation,” and “brings” is “brings about.”
NASB renders “sure” as “certain” and “seed” as “descendants”; it adds “those who are.”

NASB puts the quotation in parentheses and capitals, renders “before whom he believed God” as “in the sight of Him whom he believed, even God,” and renders the last clause as “calls into being that which does not exist.”
The quotation is in capitals; “offspring” is rendered “DESCENDANTS.”
NASB follows the critical text without “not” before “considered”; “considered” is rendered “contemplated,” and it adds “as good as” and “since.”
NASB renders “was strengthened” as “grew strong.”

NASB renders “is about to be credited” as “will be reckoned” and adds “as.”
NASB renders “for” as “because of” and “trespasses” as “transgressions.”
